title: China flags APEC's role as key for a challenged global economy
description: During the opening of the APEC Finance Ministers' meeting in Hong Kong, China's Finance Minister Lan Foan highlighted the importance of the APEC forum for promoting economic cooperation. He urged the 21 member countries to work together in addressing global economic challenges, stressing collaboration in sectors such as artificial intelligence, the digital economy, and green initiatives. Lan reaffirmed China's commitment to broad economic reforms designed to stimulate growth.

title: French bond yields edge down, but investors stay on alert
description: On Tuesday, French government bond yields lowered after a significant increase observed on the previous day. Investors are remaining cautious as they await a crucial vote on the budget bill. Recent protests highlighted challenges in reducing France's large fiscal deficit, which impacts market sentiment. Meanwhile, euro zone benchmark Bund yields also edged lower as energy price pressures persist.

title: European stocks extend slide as French protests dent risk appetite
description: Political turmoil in France has cast a shadow over European markets, leading investors to adopt a more cautious stance. The STOXX 600 index slid by 0.27% following a prior drop of 0.8%. Widespread protests have intensified economic strife alongside mounting government debt. Amidst this unrest, OVHcloud, a French cloud services provider, reported robust revenue growth and its first positive levered free cash flow.

title: EAAA India Alternatives to float Rs 1,200-cr IPO on Oct 26
description: EAAA India Alternatives Ltd will open its initial public offering worth Rs 1,200 crore on October 26. The IPO will close for subscription on October 28, following anchor investor bidding on October 23. This offering is entirely an offer for sale from the Edelweiss Group with no fresh issue component. Additionally, SEC Environmental Technologies Ltd plans to launch its IPO on October 27.

title: Jio IPO opens tomorrow: How can investors maximise allotment chances under Rs 2,500 crore RIL shareholders quota
description: The much-anticipated Reliance Jio Platforms IPO is launching for public subscription starting October 21, 2023. Shareholders of Reliance Industries can benefit from a Rs 2,500 crore reservation aimed at maximizing their investment opportunities. Those eligible are encouraged to apply in both the shareholder and retail categories. Shares are priced between Rs 1,065 and Rs 1,119, with allotments set for October 26 and listings on October 28.

title: WhatsApp stock tips: Nithin Kamath warns of more pump-and-dump schemes as ED freezes accounts worth Rs 200 crore
description: In a post on X, formerly Twitter, Kamath said such schemes remain a concern even in 2026, calling them one of the silliest ways for investors to lose money. He also warned that these cases could become more frequent as the market cycle advances, pointing to a rise in alleged pump-and-dump schemes operating through WhatsApp groups and influencers promoting stocks and initial public offerings (IPOs).

title: Japan's 20-year bond yield falls sharply after strongest auction on record
description: Japan's 20-year government bond yield saw a notable decline following a record demand from its recent auction. This drop marked the lowest yield since early September, driven by investor confidence in the Bank of Japan's interest rate stability. The strong auction signals a cautious sentiment among investors, influenced by recent global developments. Other bond yields mirrored this downward trend, showcasing broader market behaviors.

title: Bank of Japan may raise inflation forecast, stand pat on rates, sources say
description: The Bank of Japan plans to slightly upgrade its fiscal year 2027 inflation forecasts this month. Interest rates are expected to remain stable at 1.25% during the upcoming policy meeting in late October. While inflation risks are present, there is no immediate urgency for further rate hikes. Recent data indicates that inflationary pressures are not escalating significantly at this time.

title: Yen jumps after JGB auction draws big demand, euro finds relief
description: The yen experienced a notable rise against the dollar, driven by unprecedented demand for long-term Japanese government bonds. In France, curfews were enacted in response to widespread anti-government protests, which pose challenges for President Emmanuel Macron's administration. Meanwhile, the euro gained momentum alongside a rise in European bond futures amid persistent political uncertainties in France and Italy.
